Create a new NIS study folder

Source: R/nis-new-study.R
nis_new_study.Rd

Copy the packaged Quarto study template to a new directory. The destination must not already exist.

Usage

nis_new_study(path)

Arguments

path

A new local directory path for the study.

Value

The normalized path to the created study directory.

See also

Get started with easyNIS.

Examples

study_path <- tempfile("nis-study-example-")
nis_new_study(study_path)
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpEjnBNk/nis-study-example-1cca18401722"
list.files(study_path, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE)
#> [1] ".gitignore"   "_quarto.yml"  "analysis.qmd"
